p3_b0.ocr: The following table presents a comprehensive overview of various studies evaluating the biochemical parameters of patients subjected to different treatment modalities. Specifically, the focus is on the levels of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) measured in mU/mL, which serves as a critical indicator of liver function and cellular integrity.

p3_b1.ocr: In particular, the data reveals notable differences in AST levels across different patient groups, including those categorized under Sham and BDL (Bile Duct Ligation) conditions. For instance, the average AST level recorded for the BDL group is significantly elevated at 647.7 ± 105 mU/mL, suggesting a marked hepatic response to the induced pathology.
